lines: 回答柔和，使怒消退；
言语暴戾，触动怒气。
A gentle answer turns away wrath
but a harsh word stirs up anger.
回答柔和，使怒消退；
言语暴戾，触动怒气。
回答柔和，使怒消退；
言語暴戾，觸動怒氣。
A gentle answer turns away wrath
but a harsh word stirs up anger.
By a soft answer wrath is turned away
but a bitter word is a cause of angry feelings.
不先商议，所谋无效；
谋士众多，所谋乃成。
Where there is no counsel
plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
不先商议，所谋无效；
谋士众多，所谋乃成。
不先商議，所謀無效；
謀士眾多，所謀乃成。
Where there is no counsel
plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
Where there are no wise suggestions
purposes come to nothing; but by a number of wise guides they are made certain.
义人的心，思量如何回答；
恶人的口吐出恶言。
The heart of the righteous weighs answers
but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
义人的心，思量如何回答；
恶人的口吐出恶言。
義人的心，思量如何回答；
惡人的口吐出惡言。
The heart of the righteous weighs answers
but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
The heart of the upright gives thought to his answer; but from the mouth of the evil-doer comes a stream of evil things.
骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
Pride goes before destruction
and a haughty spirit before a fall.
骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
驕傲在敗壞以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
Pride goes before destruction
and a haughty spirit before a fall.
Pride goes before destruction
and a stiff spirit before a fall.
良言如同蜂房，使心觉甘甜，
使骨得医治。
Pleasant words are a honeycomb
sweet to the soul
and health to the bones.
良言如同蜂房，使心觉甘甜，
使骨得医治。
良言如同蜂房，使心覺甘甜，
使骨得醫治。
Pleasant words are a honeycomb
sweet to the soul
and health to the bones.
Pleasing words are like honey
sweet to the soul and new life to the bones.
你所作的，要交托耶和华，
你所谋的，就必成立。
Commit your deeds to Yahweh
and your plans shall succeed.
你所作的，要交托耶和华，
你所谋的，就必成立。
你所作的，要交託耶和華，
你所謀的，就必成立。
Commit your deeds to Yahweh
and your plans shall succeed.
Put your works into the hands of the Lord
and your purposes will be made certain.
喜乐的心乃是良药；
忧伤的灵使骨枯干。
A cheerful heart makes good medicine
but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
喜乐的心乃是良药；
忧伤的灵使骨枯干。
喜樂的心乃是良藥；
憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。
A cheerful heart makes good medicine
but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
A glad heart makes a healthy body
but a crushed spirit makes the bones dry.
子孙为老人的冠冕；
父亲是儿女的荣耀。
Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
子孙为老人的冠冕；
父亲是儿女的荣耀。
子孫為老人的冠冕；
父親是兒女的榮耀。
Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
Children's children are the crown of old men
and the glory of children is their fathers.
遮掩人过的，寻求人爱；
屡次挑错的，离间密友。
He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
遮掩人过的，寻求人爱；
屡次挑错的，离间密友。
遮掩人過的，尋求人愛；
屢次挑錯的，離間密友。
He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
He who keeps a sin covered is looking for love; but he who keeps on talking of a thing makes division between friends.
未曾听完先回答的，
便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
He who gives answer before he hears
that is folly and shame to him.
未曾听完先回答的，
便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
未曾聽完先回答的，
便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
He who gives answer before he hears
that is folly and shame to him.
To give an answer before hearing is a foolish thing and a cause of shame.
愚昧人不喜爱明哲，
只喜爱显露心意。
A fool has no delight in understanding
but only in revealing his own opinion.
愚昧人不喜爱明哲，
只喜爱显露心意。
愚昧人不喜愛明哲，
只喜愛顯露心意。
A fool has no delight in understanding
but only in revealing his own opinion.
A foolish man has no pleasure in good sense
but only to let what is in his heart come to light.
滥交朋友的，自取败坏；
但有一朋友，比弟兄更亲密。
A man of many companions may be ruined
but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
滥交朋友的，自取败坏；
但有一朋友，比弟兄更亲密。
濫交朋友的，自取敗壞；
但有一朋友，比弟兄更親密。
A man of many companions may be ruined
but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
There are friends who may be a man's destruction
but there is a lover who keeps nearer than a brother.
谨守口与舌的，就保守自己免受灾难。
Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
谨守口与舌的，就保守自己免受灾难。
謹守口與舌的，就保守自己免受災難。
Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
He who keeps watch over his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
教养孩童，使他走当行的道，
就是到老他也不偏离。
Train up a child in the way he should go
and when he is old he will not depart from it.
教养孩童，使他走当行的道，
就是到老他也不偏离。
教養孩童，使他走當行的道，
就是到老他也不偏離。
Train up a child in the way he should go
and when he is old he will not depart from it.
If a child is trained up in the right way
even when he is old he will not be turned away from it.
不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，
他必不至于死。
你要用杖打他，就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod
he will not die.
Punish him with the rod
and save his soul from Sheol.
不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，
他必不至于死。
你要用杖打他，就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，
他必不至於死。
你要用杖打他，就可以救他的靈魂免下陰間。
Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod
he will not die.
Punish him with the rod
and save his soul from Sheol.
Do not keep back training from the child: for even if you give him blows with the rod
it will not be death to him.
Give him blows with the rod
and keep his soul safe from the underworld.
应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。
應對正直的，猶如與人親嘴。
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
He gives a kiss with his lips who gives a right answer.
房屋因智慧建造，又因聪明立稳；
其中因知识充满各样美好宝贵的财物。
Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
房屋因智慧建造，又因聪明立稳；
其中因知识充满各样美好宝贵的财物。
房屋因智慧建造，又因聰明立穩；
其中因知識充滿各樣美好寶貴的財物。
Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
The building of a house is by wisdom
and by reason it is made strong:
And by knowledge its rooms are full of all dear and pleasing things.
你与邻舍争讼，要与他一人辩论，
不可泄漏人的密事，
Debate your case with your neighbor
and don’t betray the confidence of another;
你与邻舍争讼，要与他一人辩论，
不可泄漏人的密事，
你與鄰舍爭訟，要與他一人辯論，
不可洩漏人的密事，
Debate your case with your neighbor
and don’t betray the confidence of another;
Have a talk with your neighbour himself about your cause
but do not give away the secret of another:
过路被事激动，管理不干己的争竞，
好像人揪住狗耳。
Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
过路被事激动，管理不干己的争竞，
好像人揪住狗耳。
過路被事激動，管理不幹己的爭競，
好像人揪住狗耳。
Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
He who gets mixed up in a fight which is not his business
is like one who takes a dog by the ears while it is going by.
人欺凌邻舍，却说：「我岂不是戏耍吗？」他就像疯狂的人抛掷火把、利箭，
与杀人的兵器。
并于上节
Like a madman who shoots torches
arrows
and death
is the man who deceives his neighbor and says
“Am I not joking?”
人欺凌邻舍，却说：「我岂不是戏耍吗？」他就像疯狂的人抛掷火把、利箭，
与杀人的兵器。
并于上节
人欺凌鄰舍，卻說：「我豈不是戲耍嗎？」他就像瘋狂的人拋擲火把、利箭，
與殺人的兵器。
併於上節
Like a madman who shoots torches
arrows
and death
is the man who deceives his neighbor and says
“Am I not joking?”
As one who is off his head sends about flaming sticks and arrows of death,
So is the man who gets the better of his neighbour by deceit
and says
Am I not doing so in sport?
